# MyInviteQR

> MyInviteQR is a web app for creating digital invitations with a QR code, sharing them by link and tracking RSVPs online. It serves customers in the United States.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://myinviteqr.com/): overview and live demo
- [How it works](https://myinviteqr.com/how-it-works.html): four steps from event to shared invitation
- [Templates](https://myinviteqr.com/templates.html): fifty designer invitation templates
- [Pricing](https://myinviteqr.com/pricing.html): Essential $9.99, Premium $19.99 (one-time, USD), 6-month extension $6.99
- [QR code invitations](https://myinviteqr.com/qr-code-invitations.html)
- [Online RSVP](https://myinviteqr.com/online-rsvp.html)
- [FAQ](https://myinviteqr.com/faq.html)

## Facts
- Designing is free; payment happens once per event when publishing (Stripe).
- Essential: up to 50 guests, 90 days. Premium: up to 1,000 guests, unlimited reminders, analytics, custom link, no branding.
- Guests need no account or app.
